name: alert-dialog
docs: Imports the plugin's `utils` and `button` from @bb-plugins/ui; add @bb-plugins/utils and @bb-plugins/button only to a plugin that lacks them, since a plugin's copy may export extra helpers. Also imports @bb/portal-scope. bb's items set a fixed target, so run `bunx shadcn@latest add @bb/portal-scope`, move only those files into the plugin's ui, lib, or hooks folder, and delete the other files it writes: this registry already provides overlay-trigger, its hooks, and utils.
